lines.line: Summary: The first world's boss, a triceratops you race in a car up a spiralling mountain in Dino Domain.

quoted: Tricky is a large triceratops and the first boss of Diddy Kong Racing
Tricky is located in Dino Domain, on his own course
Tricky and the player race up a spiraling mountain
Tricky Challenge || Car || Tricky races the player character up a spiraling mountain.

lines.line: Weak points: Red and blue Weapon Balloons are placed on his course to help you against him. Stay out of his path, because bumping into him squashes you and slows you down, and in the rematch he is faster, so you have to use the balloons to win.

quoted: there are red and blue Weapon Balloons to help the player against Tricky
The player must avoid running into Tricky, who squishes and therefore slows them down.
In the rematch, Tricky races at a faster speed, so the player has to use Weapon Balloons to win the rematch.

lines.line: Looks like: A large red triceratops with yellow stripes on his back and yellow eyes with red irises.

quoted: Tricky is a large triceratops
Tricky's body is red with yellow stripes on his back, and his eyes are yellow with red irises and black pupils.

lines.line: Tips: He just keeps charging forward. Boulders now and then come down the mountain, and the second race adds more boulders plus pillars that fall.

quoted: Beyond constantly charging forward and potentially flattening the player, he has no special behavior. Boulders occasionally travel down the mountain. In the second race, more boulders as well as falling pillars are added.

lines.line: Tips: You can only race him once you have won every other course in the world. After you beat him he sets you the world's Silver Coin challenges, and his piece of the Wizpig amulet only comes after the harder rematch.

quoted: where the player can race him after winning every other course in the world
Tricky then challenges the player to complete every Silver Coin Challenge
awards the racer with his piece of the Wizpig amulet

lines.line: Summary: Snowflake Mountain's boss, a walrus you race in a hovercraft down an icy ski slope.

quoted: Bluey is a large, blue walrus who lives on Timber's Island
the player can challenge Bluey in his own course of Snowflake Mountain after winning every race in said world
Bluey Challenge || Hovercraft || Bluey races on a jagged, icy, downhill ski slope full of trees to act as obstacles.

lines.line: Looks like: A large blue walrus with a tuxedo piece at his neck, which the Nintendo DS remake leaves off.

quoted: Bluey is a large, blue walrus
He also wears a tuxedo piece on his neck, although not in the remake.

lines.line: Tips: The slope is jagged and lined with trees that get in your way. Like Tricky he only charges ahead, but unlike Tricky he does not squash you.

quoted: Bluey races on a jagged, icy, downhill ski slope full of trees to act as obstacles. As with Tricky, his only behavior is stampeding forward, though he does not squish the player character.

lines.line: Tips: The rematch only comes after you finish Snowflake Mountain's Silver Coin challenges. In it Bluey is faster, and a few snowballs are added as extra obstacles.

quoted: Bluey gives them a new challenge of partaking in Snowflake Mountain's Silver Coin challenges
where Bluey is faster than before
In the second race, a few snowballs are added as further obstacles.

lines.line: Summary: Sherbet Island's boss, an octopus you race in a hovercraft for three laps around a small island.

quoted: Bubbler is a large red octopus and the third boss of Diddy Kong Racing
Bubbler is only allows the player to race him in his own course in Sherbet Island
Bubbler Challenge || Hovercraft || Bubbler swims three laps circling the sea around a small island, tossing explosive mines around him.

lines.line: Weak points: You can shoot him. Red Weapon Balloons give you missiles to fire at him during the race.

quoted: Bubbler can be attacked by the player shooting missiles at him from red Weapon Balloons.

lines.line: Looks like: A large red octopus with yellow eyes, green irises and black pupils.

quoted: Bubbler is a large red octopus
He has yellow eyes with green irises and black pupils.

lines.line: Tips: In the first race he scatters mines in the water around him, and hitting one trips you up.

quoted: Bubbler drops aquatic mines to trip his opponent.
tossing explosive mines around him

lines.line: Tips: In the rematch he is faster and swaps the mines for giant bubbles that can trap you for a while.

quoted: The second race is more challenging, since Bubbler now moves faster and drops bubbles that temporarily encapsulate the player.
In the second race, he instead launches giant bubbles that can trap the player character.

lines.line: Summary: Dragon Forest's boss, a dragon you race in a plane for three laps through caves and fields.

quoted: Smokey is a boss in Diddy Kong Racing
the player can race Smokey at his own course in Dragon Forest
In the boss race, the player has to race Smokey while in a plane.
Smokey runs and flies three laps through a series of caves and fields.

lines.line: Looks like: A dragon with an orange body, a yellow belly, face and feet, and green eyes, which makes him the only boss without yellow eyes.

quoted: His body is colored orange with a yellow belly, face, and feet, and his eyes are green (making him the only boss in the game without yellow eyes).

lines.line: Tips: He spits clouds of hot ash and drops puffs of fire behind him, and the fire can slow you down. In the rematch he flies faster and drops more of it.

quoted: Smokey drops behind puffs of fire that can slow the player.
In his second race, Smokey flies faster than before and drops behind more fireballs.
He attacks by spitting clouds of hot ash to be ran into.

lines.line: Tips: Smokey Castle, the challenge level with his name, is not where you meet him, because he does not appear there.

quoted: Smokey has a challenge level named after him, Smokey Castle, but he does not appear here.

sections.name: Taj's three vehicle races (Car, Hovercraft, Plane)

lines.line: Summary: Once you have enough Golden Balloons in Adventure Mode, Taj turns up and challenges you to race him on his flying carpet, each time in a set vehicle, and beating him earns another Golden Balloon.

quoted: After the player collects enough Golden Balloons in Adventure Mode, Taj will appear and challenge the player to a race in a specific vehicle.
The player has to race Taj, who rides a flying carpet.
After Taj is beaten, he will reward the player with another Golden Balloon.

lines.line: Weak points: Taj moves slowly in the Car Challenge, which makes it the easy one. The Hovercraft Challenge is somewhat harder, and the Plane Challenge is considered the hardest of the three.

quoted: Car Challenge is a relatively easy race done in a car.
This should be very easy for the player because of Taj's slow movement.
Hovercraft Challenge is the second of Taj's races and is somewhat more difficult than the Car Challenge.
Plane Challenge is considered to be the hardest of Taj's three races and a plane is used in it.

lines.line: Looks like: A blue elephant who is also a genie and rides a magic red carpet.

quoted: Taj is a blue elephant and a genie who lives on Timber's Island.
Taj uses a magic red carpet for transportation as well as in his vehicle races

lines.line: Tips: Red flags showing the Nintendo 64 logo mark the route, and you have to follow them. Leaving the track by too far a margin gets you disqualified.

quoted: The racetrack is marked with red flags showing the Nintendo 64 logo and the player has to follow them. If they leave the set track by too far a margin, they will be disqualified.

lines.line: Tips: Once a race is unlocked you can run it again whenever you like, but each one gives only a single Golden Balloon.

quoted: each of them can be repeated at any time after they have been unlocked (the player will only obtain one Golden Balloon per challenge however).

lines.line: Summary: In Tracks mode, Time Trial has you race T.T.'s best times. It is optional for the adventure, but beating him on every course is what makes T.T. playable.

quoted: Time Trial mode is also accessed here, where the player needs to race to beat T.T.'s best times. This is optional in the main game, but it is required to unlock T.T. himself.
if they can beat T.T. in all races, he will become playable

lines.line: Looks like: T.T. himself is an animated stopwatch with a red outer shell, a yellow inner case and a blue button on his head, plus black arms and legs with white gloves and shoes.

quoted: T.T. is an animated stopwatch
T.T. has a pair of two black arms and legs, with a white glove on each hand and a white shoe on each foot.
There is a blue button on his head, and T.T.'s outer shell is red, while his inner case is yellow.

lines.line: Tips: Each course has two times, an unlock time that brings out T.T.'s ghost and then a lower ghost time to beat. Dino Domain's four are Ancient Lake 1:07.00 then 1:01.28, Fossil Canyon 1:37.00 then 1:30.16, Jungle Falls 1:08.00 then 1:02.50 and Hot Top Volcano 1:35.00 then 1:30.71.

quoted: The player must get good enough times around tracks in Time Trials mode to unlock T.T.'s ghost for each course, and then beat each.
Course !! Unlock time !! Ghost time

lines.line: Summary: Eight coins to find on each course. Collect all eight and win the race to earn a Golden Balloon.

quoted: Every course has a Silver Coin Challenge, where the objective is to collect eight Silver Coins and win in first place.
Collecting every one in a Silver Coin Challenge rewards a Golden Balloon.
Eight Silver Coins appear in each standard race course for their Coin Challenges.

lines.line: Uses: Taj hands over the Golden Balloon when you finish a challenge. A world's challenges only open after you have beaten its boss once, and each course has its own minimum number of Golden Balloons before you can play its challenge.

quoted: When the player's racer completes a Silver Coin Challenge, Taj awards them with a Golden Balloon.

The player can only participate in a world's Silver Coin Challenges after winning against the world boss in a race, and every race course has their own minimum requirement of Golden Balloons needed to play the challenges.

lines.line: Looks like: In the original game each coin has a colourful N64 icon on its sides.

quoted: the Silver Coins have a colorful N64 icon designed on the sides

lines.line: Tips: Many of the coins are well hidden or sit off the track.

quoted: Many of them are well hidden or located off-track.

lines.line: Tips: Clearing the Silver Coin Challenge on all four courses of a world sets up the rematch with that world's boss. In Adventure Two the coins are in different places, often hard to reach.

quoted: Completing the Silver Coin Challenge in all four courses of Dino Domain, Snowflake Mountain, Sherbet Island and Dragon Forest engages the player in a rematch against the world's boss
the locations of the silver coins are different, often in hard to reach places
